env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: we design the DSA as a generic LLM coding agent operating under strict constraints
env_context_strategy.note: Paper describes a generic coding agent working over specification and implementation files; no explicit retrieval or context injection described.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the implementation and proof are passed to Rocq's type-checker. If there are no errors, the state is saved
observation_format.note: Type-checker diagnostics and benchmark measurements are textual.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: If there are no errors, the state is saved, building a search tree of well-typed partial implementations and proofs. If errors occur, the agent can take the following actions: (1) repair the failed step
loop_primitives.note: Verification (Rocq type-check) plus benchmarking act as the verifier in a generate-verify-repair loop; coordinator runs a parallel pool of DSA workers.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Guided by a strategy, a DSA recursively decomposes a component and its specification into sub-components using placeholders.
planning_granularity.note: Strategy proposed by the ISA is a free-text high-level design rather than a stored structured plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The coordinator launches and orchestrates the DSAs and the ISA, maintaining overall system state and managing a parallel pool of workers.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: reloaderrespawns a DSA with a fresh design on strategic dead-ends

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: IDS produces a complete verified implementation on all 7 in about 6.8 hours and $106 per spec on average, with no human intervention or fine-tuning.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The coordinator launches and orchestrates the DSAs and the ISA, maintaining overall system state
short_term_state.note: Search tree of saved well-typed partial states plus recorded failed strategies.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: The ISA fills this gap as a stateless LLM agent that reasons over a strategy summary
long_term_memory.note: Failed strategies are recorded within a run only; no cross-run memory described for IDS.

state_persistence.note: CLI flag for the SkyDiscover framework (skydiscover-run); the excerpt does not show whether it applies to the IDS synthesis path. The README line number is not given in the excerpt.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the coordinator audits the result to ensure it is fully verified, non-trivial, and implements the expected interface
self_verification.note: Rocq type-checker gives formal verification; benchmark harness runs the extracted code; audit step checks non-vacuity.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: the reloader intervenes by respawning the DSA with an entirely new high-level design
retry_policy.note: Retries continue until a proof closes or the time budget expires.

rollback.evidence_quote: If progress stalls (measured by the number of partial proofs left empty), IDS reverts to an earlier state.
rollback.note: Revert to an earlier saved node in the search tree of partial states.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Finally, it returns the most efficient verified solution found within the time budget.
termination_condition.note: Run ends when the proof closes and audit passes, or when the time budget expires; time budget is a wall-clock cap rather than a step cap.

timeouts.evidence_quote: it returns the most efficient verified solution found within the time budget

execution_isolation.note: Paper mentions per-DSA workspaces and a distributed testbed benchmark harness but does not state the isolation mechanism.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: IDS suite:six new Rocq specifications for distributed key-value-store consistency models, released as an open benchmark for verified-synthesis research.
eval_hooks.note: Benchmark harness for performance measurement is part of the architecture (Fig. 3).

guardrails.evidence_quote: implementations must be well-typed before proving, specifications cannot be altered, final outputs must contain no unproven assumptions
guardrails.note: Constraints plus the audit step block invalid results.

target_domain.evidence_quote: the first agentic system to autonomously generateverifieddis-tributed systems

open_source.note: SkyDiscover repo hosting the IDS tooling is Apache-2.0; IDS-specific code not separately located in evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
SkyDiscover uses [LiteLLM](https://docs.litellm.ai/) under the hood, so any
compatible model works
model_agnostic.note: IDS paper evaluates with multiple frontier models (GPT-5.4, Opus 4.6).

primary_artifact.note: Repo evidence contains only the general SkyDiscover framework; IDS itself is coded from the paper.

first_release_date.note: Basis: paper v1 date; no tagged release available in evidence.
